text.dial-inbound: Please enter or say your 12-digit agent pairing code. If you enter it on your keypad, press star when you’re done.
text.dial-inbound-retry: Sorry, that Agent Pairing Code did not connect. Say all 12 digits, then pause. Or enter all 12 digits on your keypad and press star.
text.dial-repeat: Welcome back. I’ve sent a secure verification request to your trusted device. Confirm it with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passkey to continue. To use a new Agent Pairing Code instead, press hash.

note: Budget is user ceiling; provider streaming speech response supplies no actual billing counter. Short fixed inputs and one request per clip. No acceptance regeneration.
